description: Urban Development Authority - Notice of approval of the Development Plan for the Urban Development area of the Urban Council and Part of the Pradeshiya Sabha Area of Embilipitiya
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property-related matters, specifically the approval of a development plan for the urban development area of Embilipitiya. It involves land use planning and zoning changes for a specific geographic area, which falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa, it does not focus on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the regulatory approval of a land development plan.
